_doc: A whiskey bottle (PropModels.bottle: dark glass, cork, paper label; three glass colours by variant), a prop that shatters (GlassProp). Bottle glass ~4 mm; ~0.6 l of whiskey in it (1.2 kg full). Thick glass: a fall onto a wooden floor breaks it at about 4.5 m/s (a metre's drop); blast overpressure past ~60 kPa breaks it where it stands. The neck with its cork often comes through whole. docs/briefs/prop-lab.md, src/props/glass_prop.gd.
